description:
Job Description: Finance Executive Zoho Books & Payroll 
 Department: Finance & Accounts
 Employment Type: Full-Time (Work from Office)
 Industry: IT Services / Software Development
 Experience: 3 - 6 Years Job Location: Coimbatore - Tamil Nadu 
 Job Summary We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Finance Executive to manage the company's accounting operations using Zoho Books. The role involves maintaining accurate financial records, managing day-to-day accounting activities, handling payroll processing and validation, preparing financial reports, and supporting management with financial insights. 
 The ideal candidate must have excellent hands-on experience in Zoho Books, strong accounting knowledge, exceptional numerical and analytical skills, and practical experience in payroll processing and validation. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Accounting Operations Manage day-to-day accounting transactions using Zoho Books. Record sales invoices, customer receipts, vendor bills, payments, expenses, and journal entries. Maintain Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP). Perform monthly bank, credit card, vendor, and customer reconciliations. Maintain fixed asset registers and depreciation schedules. Monitor cash flow, outstanding receivables, payables, and working capital requirements. Ensure accurate classification and recording of all financial transactions. 2. Zoho Books Management Demonstrate strong hands-on expertise in Zoho Books and manage accounting activities independently. Maintain the Chart of Accounts, tax settings, opening balances, and accounting records. Generate financial reports and dashboards. Ensure data accuracy, proper ledger maintenance, and appropriate accounting controls. Identify and resolve discrepancies in accounting records. Improve accounting workflows and streamline routine processes within Zoho Books. 3. Payroll Processing & Validation Independently manage monthly payroll processing and validate payroll inputs before finalization. Verify employee attendance, leave records, salary inputs, incentives, reimbursements, and deductions. Validate salary calculations, new joiners, employee exits, salary revisions, and full-and-final settlements. Check payroll reports for calculation errors, duplicate entries, missing information, and unusual month-on-month variations. Reconcile payroll data with employee records, previous-month payroll, and actual salary payments. Coordinate with HR to resolve discrepancies in employee master data and salary inputs. Ensure payroll summaries are accurate and approved before salary disbursement. Record salary expenses, deductions, reimbursements, and payroll liabilities accurately in Zoho Books. 4. Financial Reporting & MIS Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements. Generate Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets, Cash Flow statements, and MIS reports. Analyze expenses, financial performance, and variances. Provide management with accurate financial analysis and business insights. Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning. Ensure timely monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial closure. 5. Taxation, Compliance & Audit Coordination Maintain accurate accounting records to support GST, TDS, and other applicable statutory requirements. Assist in GST return preparation, reconciliations, and supporting documentation. Coordinate with the dedicated payroll compliance team for statutory deductions, compliance requirements, and related filings. Prepare schedules and documentation for statutory and tax audits. Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, and relevant stakeholders. Ensure financial records are complete, accurate, and audit-ready. 6. Process Improvement & Internal Controls Develop and maintain accounting Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Improve accounting processes, reconciliation procedures, and internal financial controls. Maintain proper financial documentation and records. Recommend improvements to reduce accounting errors and improve operational efficiency. 
 Required Qualifications B.Com, M.Com, MBA Finance, CA Inter, CMA Inter, or an equivalent qualification. 3-6 years of relevant experience in accounting and finance operations. Excellent hands-on experience with Zoho Books is mandatory. Practical experience in payroll processing and payroll validation. Strong understanding of accounting principles, bookkeeping, and financial reporting. Working knowledge of GST, TDS, and Indian statutory compliance requirements. Proficiency in MS Excel, including formulas, PivotTables, and lookup functions. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience in IT Services, Software Development, SaaS, or Consulting. Familiarity with project-based billing and service accounting. Experience in monthly financial closure, MIS reporting, and audit coordination. 
 Key Skills Zoho Books Advanced Practical Knowledge Financial Accounting & Bookkeeping Payroll Processing & Validation Bank and Ledger Reconciliation Accounts Payable & Receivable Financial Reporting & MIS GST & TDS Knowledge Advanced MS Excel Strong Numerical and Analytical Skills Attention to Detail and Problem-Solving Confidentiality and Financial Discipline 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Accuracy and completeness of accounting entries in Zoho Books. Timely monthly account closure and financial reporting. Accuracy of payroll inputs, calculations, and payroll summaries. Timely completion of bank and ledger reconciliations. Accuracy of financial reports and management information. Prompt identification and resolution of accounting and payroll discrepancies. 
 Ideal Candidate: A numbers-oriented finance professional with 45 years of experience, excellent Zoho Books expertise, and the ability to independently manage accounting operations, payroll processing and validation, reconciliations, and financial reporting while coordinating with the dedicated payroll team for statutory compliance.

title: Accounts Executive
description:
Location: Coimbatore (Onsite) Experience: 2 - 4 years (Hands-on) 
 
 Job Summary 
 Were looking for a hands-on Accounts Executive who can independently manage day-to-day bookkeeping, compliance, and reporting for a growing consulting firm serving global clients. Youll work closely with leadership to keep the books accurate, compliance timelines met, and financial reporting audit-ready. Youll take ownership of the full accounting cycle-from transaction entry to PL and balance sheet reporting-while coordinating statutory filings and payroll-related compliance across multiple organizations/entities under our umbrella. If youre detail-oriented, dependable, and comfortable owning numbers end-to-end, this role is for you. Were a firm thats constantly picking up new tools, so youll fit right in if you enjoy figuring out a better, faster way to do something rather than sticking to the same process out of habit. Given that youll be handling sensitive financials across multiple entities, this is a role built on trust - someone we can hand the numbers to and not have to double-check. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Maintain books of accounts for multiple entities/organizations in parallel, keeping each set of records distinct and audit-ready. Maintain day-to-day bookkeeping and ledgers in Zoho Books . Perform regular expense reconciliations (bank, vendor, and credit card). Prepare and maintain the Chart of Accounts . Prepare PL statements, Balance Sheets, projections, and budgets for management review. Track and report on cash flow , flagging shortfalls or timing gaps proactively. Process payroll accurately and on time, including statutory deductions. Maintain Asset Management records (fixed assets, depreciation schedules). Handle GST and TDS computation, payment, and return filing (including quarterly TDS filings). Ensure compliance with Professional Tax, PF, Gratuity, and Shop Establishment registrations and renewals. Support Income Tax related filings and coordination with auditors/consultants. Manage client and vendor invoicing , including follow-up on outstanding receivables. Handle multi-currency transactions (USD billing) and reconcile FX conversions. Support audit requirements by preparing schedules and responding to auditor queries. Keep records in Zoho Books clean and consistent, so reports and dashboards stay reliable. Use AI tools to improve accuracy and speed of recurring accounting tasks. Maintain clear, professional written communication with internal teams, vendors, and clients over email. 
 
 Early Impact 
 Weeks 1-2: Understand our accounting systems, chart of accounts, compliance calendar, and ongoing processes. By ~60 days: Independently manage bookkeeping, reconciliations, and routine compliance filings with minimal supervision. By ~90 days: Own the monthly close process end-to-end, including PL/Balance Sheet preparation, and proactively flag compliance deadlines, cash flow gaps, and budget variances before theyre asked about. 
 
 Must-haves 
 2-4 years of hands-on experience in Accounting and Bookkeeping. Proven experience managing books for multiple organizations/entities simultaneously , keeping each set of accounts separate and accurate. Strong working knowledge of Zoho Books (or equivalent accounting software). Proficiency in Excel (formulas, reconciliations, reporting). Practical experience with GST and TDS compliance, including quarterly TDS filings. Experience preparing PL statements, Balance Sheets, projections, and budgets . Good understanding of cash flow - tracking inflows/outflows and anticipating shortfalls. Experience maintaining a Chart of Accounts . Experience with payroll processing and statutory deductions. Experience with Asset Management (fixed asset tracking, depreciation). Working knowledge of Professional Tax, PF, Gratuity, and Shop Establishment compliance. Comfort using AI tools to support accounting workflows. Strong written communication skills, especially over email. Someone who takes ownership of the numbers, follows through without needing reminders, and is comfortable being the person others can rely on when it matters. 
 
 Good to Have 
 Prior experience in a consulting or services firm billing international clients. Exposure to Income Tax filings and audit coordination. Experience working directly with external auditors, CAs, or compliance consultants. Experience handling client/vendor invoicing and receivables follow-up. Exposure to multi-currency accounting , particularly USD billing and FX reconciliation. 
 
 Skills 
 Zoho Books Excel AI Tools GST TDS Income Tax Bookkeeping Multi-Entity Accounting Expense Reconciliations PL Balance Sheets Cash Flow Projections Budgets Chart of Accounts Payroll Processing Asset Management Professional Tax PF Gratuity Shop Establishment Compliance Client Vendor Invoicing Multi-Currency Accounting Audit Support Written Communication 
 
 Educational Qualifications 
 We care more about the quality of your work and thinking than specific degrees. A strong track record in similar roles matters most.
